create.name: Cissi Williams
create.bio:
Cissi Williams is a Swedish-born teacher of shamanic energy medicine who leads the Nordic Light Academy of Energy Medicine. Her spiritual path began in London in the early 1990s with A Course in Miracles; she went on to qualify in osteopathy and naturopathy at the British College of Osteopathic Medicine and later trained in neuro-linguistic programming and hypnosis. Her shamanic studies started in Andean and Amazonian lineages, including time with Q'ero elders in Peru, and then turned towards the Norse and Celtic traditions of her own ancestry and the Glastonbury Goddess Temple.

At the heart of her teaching is the inner wise woman, met through goddess myths, the turning of the seasons, the chakras and the Norse practice of seidr, and worked with through guided shamanic journeys, ritual and prayer. The academy offers a multi-level training in shamanic energy medicine and seidr, largely online with a residential module in Glastonbury, alongside shorter online courses such as Journey through the Wheel of the Year, a shamanic course on the chakras and Say YES to Miracles, which draws on A Course in Miracles. She hosts the Awaken Your Inner Wisdom podcast, shares short recorded prayers and journeys for free, and has written a book on the four chambers of the heart as a teacher.

courses.title: Shamanic Energy Medicine and Seidr Magic Training, Level 1 (2027)
courses.description: The first level of her academy's training in shamanic energy medicine and Norse seidr, taught mostly online with a five-day residential module in Glastonbury. It can be taken for personal development or, with an added clinical module and exam, towards practitioner certification.
courses.price: £2,150 GBP (personal development, until 31 Dec 2026; full price £2,400 GBP)

courses.title: Journey through the Wheel of the Year
courses.description: An online course that follows the seasonal festivals of the year with goddess archetypes and spirit-animal guides, using shamanic journeys to work with each season's themes of darkness, light and renewal. The next round opens at the autumn equinox.

courses.title: A Shamanic Journey through the Chakras
courses.description: A seven-week self-paced online course with a guided journey into each chakra, from the root to the crown, exploring the ancestral teachings and personal gifts linked to each one.

courses.title: Say YES to Miracles
courses.description: A thirteen-week online course based on A Course in Miracles, with weekly lectures and meditations on hearing spirit's guidance rather than the ego, and lifetime access to the material.

courses.title: Introduction to Shamanic Energy Medicine and the Path of the Wise Woman
courses.description: A short five-module online introduction that moves through south, west, north and east on the medicine wheel and serves as preparation for the full training. It reopens around the winter solstice.

courses.title: The Ancient Wells of Love, Magic and Wisdom
courses.description: An online shamanic course built around the three wells beneath Yggdrasil in Norse myth, the wells of Urd, Hel and Mimir, and what each offers in love, magic and wisdom. It reopens around the winter solstice.

free_resources.title: Prayers and Meditations
free_resources.description: A free collection of her recorded morning and evening prayers, morning meditations and longer shamanic journeys, some only a minute long.

free_resources.title: Awaken Your Inner Wisdom podcast
free_resources.description: Her free podcast on goddess myths, shamanic practice and the inner wise woman, with talks, guided journeys and conversations with other teachers.
